zh: 新增翻译功能：支持翻译整条回复、思考过程、选中文本和任务详情内容，可设置目标语言、模型和提示词。
优化选中文本工具栏，在流式输出等自动滚动场景下保持显示，并改善多面板中的定位。
优化手机端设置菜单，在屏幕空间有限时调整展开位置和高度。
修复部分本地 OpenCode 服务无法检查版本更新的问题。
en: Add translation for full replies, reasoning, selected text, and task details, with configurable target language, model, and prompt.
Improve the text selection toolbar so it stays visible during automatic scrolling, such as streaming output, and positions more reliably across panes.
Improve mobile settings menus by adjusting their position and height when screen space is limited.
Fix version update checks for some local OpenCode servers.
